summary: Fixes for the two H2 reviews (design fidelity; behaviour/features/safety). All 3 majors and every minor were fixed; DF-11 and DF-18 partly (reasons below). Safety: the Command readout no longer credits demo, synthetic or local record values to an agency (issuer only when the bundle used that agency's incident record); the 'Observed fire' label and the location check's 'Not burned by' never carry a forecast or future time (past the latest observation they say 'Latest' and its own time). Behaviour: a north-up 2D map stays north up after Forensic and back (the map's own heading is restored unless the user turned the Forensic camera); ⟲ ⟳ are visible in 2D in every map chrome (default row: a short turn row under it); a town search's message and text survive the chrome swap when the fire closes. Design: basemap menu opens upward with readable two-line items; selected-point label stacks its coordinates or flips instead of running under the column or off screen, with the screen's ' · ' separator; area labels and 'Outside modeled area' labels stay off the map's own labels and the chrome; slim timeline forecast at full #f5c060 and amber stale LATEST; off-palette blue, orange links and pre-handoff feed colours replaced by tokens; opaque feed bar; 400 px search box; label halo; status age never truncated; 'Demo' badge in Command's bar; mono section titles; credits folded below 1280 px.

findings.how: MapControls BasemapMenu up (placement top-start) for bar anchor='bottom'; map-bridge.css .select-pop items wrap: label line, hint indented under it (also fixes Public). Seen: menu at y 599-808 above the bar, labels readable (scratch v-basemap.png).

pinLabel.ts pinLabelLayout: stacked coordinates option (STACKED_COST 8) and OFFSCREEN_COST_PER_PX 10; SelectionPin measures both forms (.fxm-pin.is-stacked). Lower Sugarloaf 1024 x 768: stacked up-right inside the free area; 390 px phone: stacked, inside the screen; tests for both and a dot within a label width of the right edge.

areaLabels.ts Blocked predicate on placeLeader/placeAlong; CommandAreaLabels tests each candidate box against the incident and event label/circle layers (queryRenderedFeatures) and drops the label when no slot is free (phone Lower Sugarloaf: dropped, no overlap).
compactTimeline.css: slim dimmed copy at opacity 1, only its observed lane at .55; forecast dashes full #f5c060 at the default handle.
.ctl.is-slim .ctl-stop.is-active.is-stale keeps --m-stale; the underline alone marks the active stop.
--m-info: #cfcfcf (wall-clock mark and NOW glyph, Public satellite icon, feed imagery/camera kinds, location.css); wall-clock tooltip now says 'grey dotted mark'.
.on-link, .on-link-btn, .uf-link, .os-link (and .xs-caption-more) use --m-accent-text, underlined; sampled rgb(224,224,224) on an open official row.

updatesFeed.css kind tags: observation --m-fire-3, estimate --m-fire-4 dashed, model --m-forecast dotted, official --m-official-ink, annotation --m-text-2; #8ee0a8 x3 -> --m-official-ink; #ff9ccd -> --m-alert.
.uf-bar background --m-panel-raised (rgba(26,26,26,.96)); items no longer show through.
.cmd-search-pop .loc-search {width: 100%}: box 1012-1412 = the 400 px popover.

Below 1280 px Command folds the credits behind '© Credits' (CreditsFooter fold, CREDITS_FOLD_QUERY; every text kept): +85 px for the readout at 1024 x 768. Not moved: the official block at the point stays under MODEL (PLAN-4 §3.2 'always shown under MODEL'; an evacuation order at the selected point outranks record values that the Official now column's record row also shows: acres, containment, its own time). The rows scroll into view with the fade on short windows; at 1440 x 1000 on real fires the Incident ID row is still partly below the fold (wrapped WFIGS issuer labels).

.cmd-label and the selected-point label get a four-layer dark halo (0 0 2px 1, 0 0 4px .95, 0 0 8px .9, 0 1px 2px .9 of rgba(12,12,12)); the coloured meta line sits on a soft dark plate (rgba(12,12,12,.6) + a 5 px feather). Reviewer method (text transparent, 90th-percentile background) on Eaton aerial at z9: meta 2.57:1 -> above 5.6:1 (halo alone gave 3.76), pin label 4.25 -> 4.88.

ImageryChip status: platform and pixel size in .xs-status-head (ellipsis), the age in .xs-status-tail (flex none; 'VIIRS NOAA-… 11 H AGO' at 1024); Public chip text in its own ellipsis box ('No recent satellite i…').

map/aoiLabels.ts aoiLabelBox / aoiSidesInside; the controller filters fx-aoi-label to the sides whose box stays inside the safe area (moveend, idle, safe-area change; tests). fixture-live 1440: the east and west labels next to the columns are hidden, north and south shown.

Command's bar shows the short 'Demo' badge at every width; the full 'Demo · simulated data' is the badge's accessible text (visually hidden span), its tooltip and the readout's demo note. The place now reads 'Santa Lucia Range, Los Pa…' at 1440.

areaLabels.ts observedLabelMeta + seriesAcresAt: '≈6,695 ac · Oct 22, 13:30 PDT' (the reconstructed area from the hourly series, the Analysis Fire Area line; '≈' marks the estimate; hectares in metric); falls back to the time-only line when the longer one has no room.
markers.ts fmtLatLon(lat, lon, digits, sep); the pin label renders 'lat · lon' as two spans (so it can stack).

The floating bar's text gets the readout's halo and the logo a drop-shadow on the map (topbar.css), so place labels no longer run through the title. The top band's own gradient and hiding country/state labels there stay with H3+H4, who build the Command overview (PLAN-4 decision c, §4).
.cro-more-body .mw-eyebrow: 600 10.5px JetBrains Mono, letter-spacing .14em, --m-text-3 (measured 1.47 px tracking).

observedLabelMeta clamps to manifest.time_range.now_ms: at +72 h the label reads 'Latest · Oct 22, 13:30 PDT'; unit tests for the clamp and the one-minute tolerance. Same clamp for the location check's 'Not burned by …' (locationCheck.ts not_burned asOfMs; test).

handoff.ts: map -> Forensic remembers the map heading; Forensic -> map uses returnBearing(forensic, turnedInForensic, mapBearing): the Forensic heading only after the user's own turn there (a drag that changed the heading, or a north-up / turn command), else the map's own. handoff.test.ts (4 tests) and a browser check: 0 -> Forensic 337.5 -> 0; -60 -> -60; still 2D, pitch 0.

readoutText.ts recordIssuer(issuer, manifest.data_sources, demo): the tag and the agency ID sub-line only when the bundle lists CAL FIRE or the NIFC WFIGS incident record and is not demo; else 'Record updated' and 'Reported location (incident data)'. Tests with CAL FIRE, WFIGS, synthetic and missing manifests.

Default MapControls (Public fire, overview, Command on phones) show ⟲ ⟳ in 2D on a short row under the main row (.fxm-turn-row, 44 px on phones); 3D keeps them in the orbit row. H3+H4 still switch Public to 'compact' / 'bar'.

searchUi.ts carry (SearchCarry, CARRY_MS 1500, freshCarry): when a fire opens or closes or the preset changes, a box with a message or result list open hands its text and popover to the next chrome's box (saved from zustand subscriptions before React renders the next chrome). Browser check: Command 'Monterey' -> pick -> fire closes -> overview box shows 'Monterey' and 'Showing Monterey, CA … click the map.'

gates: typecheck ok / lint 55 warnings, all in src/scene (0 elsewhere, none added) / tests 91 files: 1301 passed, 2 skipped, 0 failed / build ok
known_issues: DF-11 (partly): at 1440 x 1000 on real WFIGS fires the Incident ID row starts just below the readout's fold (the long issuer wraps the Record updated and Reported location labels); at 1024 x 768 the rows are below the official block at the point. The readout scrolls with a fade; the Official now column's record row shows acres, containment and the record time.
DF-18 (partly): on the Command overview, basemap place labels can still show faintly beside (not through) the logo and title; the top band is H3+H4's.

The 2D turn row adds a second row to the default controls (Public, overview, Command on phones); on a 390 px phone it is a 44 px pair under the 30 px row until H3+H4 move Public to the 'compact' cluster.

H5: CameraRig should apply store.flyTo.bearingDeg so the map's heading reaches Forensic; the way back is already correct without it (handoff.ts restores the map's own heading unless the user turned Forensic).
The phone 'Observed fire' label is dropped where every slot would cover the fire's REPORTED label or event dots (by design: the legend names the layer).
notes_for_others: H3+H4: map/aoiLabels.ts filters 'Outside modeled area' to the safe area for every chrome, so new [data-chrome] regions with --chrome-side keep it clear. CommandAreaLabels' placement now also avoids the map's incident and event labels/points (areaLabels.ts Blocked) - the LeaderLabels engine can reuse the predicate. SearchBox hands its open message to the next chrome's box (searchUi.ts carry) when a fire opens/closes or the preset changes; a new chrome only needs to mount SearchBox. The default MapControls row now has a 2D turn row; 'compact' / 'bar' are unchanged. H5: handoff.ts tracks the user's Forensic turns from sceneStore (cameraCommand kinds other than frame-fire / zoom-in / zoom-out, and heading changes while interacting); H5's new 'rotate' / 'set-heading' commands count automatically. Apply flyTo.bearingDeg in CameraRig.
